_about: The abandoned Emberpup (src/emberpup_encounter.py). Every run, on one floor from 3 to 8, a small fire lizard sits alone on a rock under a rain cloud, where a hard master left him. He has learned to shy from anyone bigger than he is (Brandon, 2026-11-13; the fire line is a homage, never a copy). Trust is earned: leave him food three times, at least feed_gap_turns apart (leaving his floor counts as waiting), each feed a step warmer; and keep the rain off him with the Bloomleaf Cloak, the one thing that turns it, which Old Nickel the kobold wears (src/emberpup_encounter.py, the 'cloak' block below). Only then does 'I choose you' ask the animal quiz (tier 2, two right answers). Pass and he joins you as your Emberpup, wearing the cloak at every stage of his line. The pup is 'he' throughout (Brandon's word).
name: Emberpup
_attack_karma_note: No single karma loss is bigger than one (Brandon, 2026-10-18; src/karma.py MAX_LOSS).
_first_feed_karma_note: Paid only while the karma gate is OFF. With the gate on (the default) feeding moves no karma (Brandon, decision 9; src/emberpup_encounter.py).
_visits_needed_note: Feeds before he trusts the hero (winning-build plan 3.8: 'leaving him food a few times').
_feed_gap_turns_note: Turns he needs to eat in peace between feeds (plan 3.8b). Leaving his floor counts as waiting. Sooner, and he is still eating: too_soon, and nothing counts.

cloak._doc: The one thing that turns his rain, and who wears it: Old Nickel, on one floor from first_floor to the pup's, drawn once a run with the pup's own generator (src/emberpup_encounter.py, BloomleafMixin).

title: A LONELY EMBERPUP
story: On a rock in the middle of the room sits a small orange fire lizard, all alone. A little grey cloud hangs under the ceiling above him, and the rain falls on the rock and on nothing else. His scales are soaked, and the flame on the tip of his tail has shrunk to a guttering flicker. The rain is putting his fire out.

You take a step closer and he flinches back against the stone, small and shaking. There is an old scar across his snout, and a frayed cord is knotted round the rock, as if something was once tied there and left. Whoever owned him was hard on him. Someone bigger than him has hurt him before, and you are bigger than him.

He was left here on purpose, and nobody is coming back for him. He is still here anyway, keeping his little fire alive in the rain, and it is nearly out. He watches your hands and your boots, and everything about him says run.
waiting: The Emberpup huddles on his rock in the rain. When you come near he flinches and makes himself small, the way a thing does when something bigger has hurt it before.
The Emberpup watches you from his rock. He still flinches when you move, but his eyes follow your hands now, not your boots.
The Emberpup lifts his head when you come in. He does not flinch this time, and his tail flame flickers a little brighter.
The Emberpup creeps to the edge of his rock as you come near, as close as the rain will let him. He is not afraid of you any more.
waiting_sheltered: Your leaf cloak is spread over his rock, and the rain runs off it in beads.

options.shelter: Leave him something against the rain

no_food: You search your pack, but you have nothing he could eat. The Emberpup watches you warily from his rock.
fed: You set the {food} down at the foot of his rock and step back. The Emberpup darts down, snatches it and scurries to the far side of the stone. He eats with his back to the wall, watching you carefully the whole time. He is still wary, and still hurt.
You set down the {food} and step back again. He takes the food and scampers away, but this time he lingers for a moment before he eats, and he seems to relax.

This time he does not run. He eats the {food} right in front of you, and when it is gone he edges closer and sniffs your hand, very carefully, the way a hurt thing does when it is deciding to trust. His tail flame burns steady and bright.
fed_again: He eats the {food} from your hand. His flame steadies, and he looks up at you. He is listening now.
_too_soon_note: Come back before feed_gap_turns have passed: one line per feed so far (Brandon 2026-11-14, the first line his own), the last for any later feed.
too_soon: The Emberpup, still eating the treat you provided, growls and backs away as you approach.
The Emberpup is still eating the treat you left him. He hunches over it and gives a small growl as you come near, but this time he does not run.
already_fed: He has eaten, and his flame is steady. He watches you, waiting to see what you will do.
refused: You hold out your hand and say it. The Emberpup cringes back against the stone as if you had raised a fist. He does not trust you. He does not trust anyone bigger than he is.
refused_trust: He looks at your hand, then at your face, and shrinks back. Someone bigger than him spoke kindly once, and then hurt him. He needs more time to be sure of you.
refused_hungry: He is cold and hungry again, and he will not come down. Leave him something to eat first.
refused_cold: He wants to come. But the rain is still on him and his flame is half drowned, and he will not leave his rock like that. A cloak of leaves would turn this rain.
no_shelter: You have nothing that would keep this rain off him. Cloth soaks through and iron runs wet. A cloak of leaves would turn this rain.
not_leaves: You hold your {item} over his rock, but the rain soaks through and drips on him all the same. A cloak of leaves would turn this rain.
take_off: The leaf cloak is on your own back. Take it off first, and then you can leave it over his rock.
already_sheltered: Your leaf cloak is still over his rock. Out of the rain, his flame burns straight.
sheltered: You spread the {item} over the Emberpup's rock. The rain hits the broad leaves and runs off them in beads, and for the first time in a long while no water falls on him. His tail flame steadies and stands up straight. A lizard cannot make his own warmth; he has to take it from the world, and the rain has been taking it away. The leaves are his now.
ignore: You leave the Emberpup on his rock. He watches you go.
attack: You raise your weapon. The Emberpup gives one small, frightened cry, as if he had known all along it would come to this, scrambles off the rock and flees into the dark, the little rain cloud chasing after him. You never see him again.
attack_chronicle: Hurt the fire lizard left in the rain. He fled into the dark.
pass: The Emberpup looks at you for a long moment. You are big, and you could have hurt him, and you never did. Then he climbs down off the rock with the leaf cloak still round his shoulders, walks out from under the rain, and presses his warm side against your leg. Behind him the little cloud thins and is gone. The flame on his tail blazes up bright and strong.
fail: You try, but the words do not come out right, and your voice comes out too loud. The Emberpup flinches and creeps back to the middle of his rock. He is still there. Warm and fed again, he might listen.
name_prompt: Will you give your Emberpup a name?
named_message: {name} the Emberpup will not be left behind again.
unnamed_message: Your Emberpup will not be left behind again.
named_chronicle: Found a little fire lizard left on a rock in the rain by someone who was cruel to him. I named him {name}. He wears the leaf cloak I gave him, he walks right at my heel, and I am never leaving him anywhere.
unnamed_chronicle: Found a little fire lizard left on a rock in the rain by someone who was cruel to him. He wears the leaf cloak I gave him, he walks right at my heel now, and I am never leaving him anywhere.

log.sheltered: You leave your {item} over the Emberpup's rock.
log.fled: The Emberpup flees into the dark.
log.shied: The Emberpup shies away from you.
log.joined: The Emberpup comes down off his rock to you.

pet_wears_cloak: He wears the Bloomleaf Cloak you gave him: rain runs off it, and water and cold do him no extra harm.
evolved_cloaked: The leaf cloak still hangs round his shoulders.
